definitions.explanation: Water that is safe for human consumption. Used in official, public health, and emergency contexts.

examples.japanese: {飲料水|いんりょうすい}を{確保|かくほ}してください。
この{水|みず}は{飲料水|いんりょうすい}として{使|つか}えますか。
examples.english: Can this water be used as drinking water?

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}に{備|そな}えて、{家族|かぞく}{一人|ひとり}あたり{三日分|みっかぶん}の{飲料水|いんりょうすい}を{備蓄|びちく}しておくことが{推奨|すいしょう}されている。
examples.english: It is recommended to stockpile three days' worth of drinking water per family member in preparation for disasters.

notes:
USAGE:
{飲料水|いんりょうすい} is a formal compound of {飲料|いんりょう} (beverage) and {水|すい} (water). It is used on signs, in official documents, and in disaster preparedness contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲料水|いんりょうすい}を{確保|かくほ}する (to secure drinking water)
- {飲料水|いんりょうすい}の{備蓄|びちく} (stockpile of drinking water)
- {飲料水|いんりょうすい}として{利用|りよう}する (to use as drinking water)
- {安全|あんぜん}な{飲料水|いんりょうすい} (safe drinking water)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲料水|いんりょうすい}: drinking water (formal, official)
- {飲|の}み{水|みず}: drinking water (everyday, casual)
- {水道水|すいどうすい}: tap water (from the water supply system)
